## Mandate
- Own the interfaces between Sales, Marketing, CS, Finance and Product: the definitions, the handoffs and the systems that carry them.
- Keep the working model of how the company makes revenue, and set where automation and agents may act and when they must escalate.
- Success means the commercial motion gets more effective, not just more active.

- Weekly: intake triage; release notes to the field.
- Monthly: roadmap review.
- Quarterly: charter check.

## When headcount comes
Split into Process (stakeholders, enablement), Systems (tooling, automation, AI, including an engineer) and Data (inside RevOps). See [GTM Motion and Org Design](../playbooks/GTM_Motion_and_Org_Design.md).
